general_summary: For over 30 years, Tecnidesenho is responsible for the study, conception, development and technical support of many projects and constructions on the islands of Madeira. A professional stance, makes this company a reference in Madeira’s Architecture, Urbanism and Urban Planning. Having developed more than 700 projects from many architectural disciplines, Tecnidesenho is proud to keep high quality standards in its work. A dedicated team of architects and engineers, introduce’s in our works the knowledge of 30 years of professional practice. Looking to the future with innovation and recognizing the emerging styles and building tecnologies, it’s creativity is being recognized with several prestigious awards.
